evidence_summary: About 2.8m people received social long-term care insurance benefits in 2015 vs about 6m in 2025.
limitations: Rounded; chart values not in text.

title: Neues Pflegetransparenzsystem für Heime ab 1. November 2019 (Meldung 20.03.2019)
evidence_summary: Announces that the Pflegenoten for nursing homes are replaced from November 2019 by a new quality system combining indicators collected by homes twice a year and new external MD inspections.
limitations: Search snippet only; implementation details from other sources.

title: Gesetz zur Befugniserweiterung und Entbürokratisierung in der Pflege (BEEP)
evidence_summary: BEEP (successor of the planned Pflegekompetenzgesetz) passed Bundestag 6 Nov 2025, Bundesrat 19 Dec 2025, promulgated 29 Dec 2025, mostly in force 1 Jan 2026, further parts 1 July 2026 and 1 Jan 2027.
limitations: Search summary; dates should be checked against BGBl.

title: Bundestag verabschiedet Gesetz zur Einführung eines neuen Berufsbildes Pflegefachassistenz (PM 09.10.2025)
evidence_summary: Bundestag adopted the Pflegefachassistenzgesetz on 9 Oct 2025; Bundesrat approved 17 Oct 2025; uniform federal care assistant training mainly from 1 Jan 2027.

title: Pflegereform: Ausgabenbremsen und Aufschlag für Kinderlose
evidence_summary: Referentenentwurf Pflegeneuordnungsgesetz: higher nursing-home surcharges start six months later (2.6bn EUR relief 2027), contribution for childless rises, annual benefit indexation, new Pflegebegleitung, Entlastungsbetrag 131 EUR for Pflegegrad 1 to be dropped; expected deficit 7.6bn EUR.
limitations: Draft stage; measures later changed in cabinet version.

title: Bundesregierung einigt sich auf ein Pflegegesetz
evidence_summary: Cabinet adopted the Pflegeneuordnungsgesetz (PNOG) on 30 Sept 2026: contribution rate stable at 3.6%, childless surcharge +0.3 points to 0.9%, 0.52-point surcharge for co-insured spouses, contribution ceiling +300 EUR; deficits of about 4.4bn (2026) and 7.6bn EUR (2027); expert commission to propose structural reform (target 1 July 2027).
limitations: Government draft; parliamentary process pending as of Nov 2026.

title: Viele Optionen, keine Festlegungen: Abschlussbericht zur geplanten Pflegereform
evidence_summary: The Bund-Länder working group 'Zukunftspakt Pflege' delivered its final report in Dec 2025 with options (benefit indexation, Sockel-Spitze-Tausch) but few concrete decisions, mainly on home care.

title: Ergebnisse der Ärztestatistik zum 31.12.2025
evidence_summary: About 446,000 working physicians (+2.0%); 593,000 total incl. retired; self-employed ambulatory physicians -1.3% (-8% in five years), employed ambulatory +6.7% (+48% since 2020); 23.4% aged 60+; 44% of practice owners over 60; 71,480 foreign physicians; part-time share 28% (2024) vs 15% (2014).
limitations: Headcounts; no specialty split on this page.

title: Kritischer Trend setzt sich fort: mehr Ärzte und trotzdem weniger Zeit (Arztzahlstatistik 2025)
evidence_summary: 191,875 physicians and psychotherapists in statutory ambulatory care (+1.2%); practice owners 122,903 (2024: 123,752), employed 58,877 (55,604); GPs 55,778 (55,435) but GP full-time seats -0.1%; about 5,000 GP seats unfilled; average age 53.9; women 53.2%.
limitations: Counts of persons; capacity measured differently.

title: GKV-Versichertenbefragung 2025 (Pressemitteilung)
evidence_summary: Online survey of 3,520 insured (Feb-Mar 2025): 30% rate specialist waiting times as too long; a quarter waits more than 30 days for a specialist appointment; 86% find GP waiting acceptable.

title: GKV-Patienten warten insgesamt 42 Tage auf Facharzttermine
evidence_summary: Citing a federal government answer: statutory insured waited on average 42 days for a specialist appointment in 2024 vs 33 days in 2019.
limitations: Search summary; method of underlying survey not verified.

title: Über 50 Prozent der GKV-Patienten wartet länger als vier Wochen auf Facharzttermin (TK/forsa)
evidence_summary: TK-commissioned forsa survey of 1,410 adults: more than half of statutory insured wait over four weeks for a specialist appointment.

title: Statistik Terminservicestellen
evidence_summary: 2025: 1,937,494 booked appointments/legitimate requests excluding cancellations (2,106,865 incl.); about 98% within deadline; only about 46% of 116117 search requests led to a timely appointment; highest strain in endocrinology, rheumatology, psychotherapy, neurology/psychiatry.

title: Terminservicestellen vermitteln rund zwei Millionen Termine (Praxisnachrichten 05.02.2026)
evidence_summary: TSS bookings doubled within two years: about 1.1m (2023), 1.5m (2024), over 2m (2025), of which about 980,000 online.

title: Der Hausarzt als Lotse? Was sich für Patienten ändern könnte
evidence_summary: Planned Primärarztsystem: GP as mandatory first contact with digital/telephone initial assessment via 116117 and appointment guarantee; draft bill expected end Nov 2026, start planned 1 Jan 2028.
limitations: Search summary; no draft bill published yet.

publisher: Institut Arbeit und Qualifikation, Universität Duisburg-Essen (sozialpolitik-aktuell.de)
title: Krankenhäuser und Betten nach Trägerschaft 2002-2024 (abbVI32b)
evidence_summary: Hospitals fell from 2,221 (2002) to 1,841 (2024); beds from 547k to 473k; private share of hospitals 24% to 40%, public 37% to 29%.
limitations: Based on Destatis Grunddaten; counts of hospitals not sites.

title: 1,2 % mehr Krankenhausbehandlungen im Jahr 2025 (PM 376, Oktober 2026)
evidence_summary: 2025: 17.7m inpatient cases (+1.2%), still 9.4% below 2019 (19.4m); 1,807 hospitals; 468,803 beds (-0.9%); occupancy 72.6%; 221,800 physicians and 1,271,700 non-medical staff; average stay 7.0 days.

title: Das Krankenhausreformanpassungsgesetz (KHAG) – Die Reform der Krankenhausreform
evidence_summary: KHVVG in force 1 Jan 2025; KHAG approved by Bundesrat 27 March 2026; Leistungsgruppen reduced from 65 to 61; Vorhaltevergütung start postponed to 1 Jan 2028, transition ends 2032; Transformationsfonds half Länder, half federal; insurer relief stated as 25bn EUR.
limitations: Law firm summary, not official text.

title: Federal clinic atlas goes offline, consumer advocates criticize
evidence_summary: Bundes-Klinik-Atlas launched 17 May 2024; project group dissolved retroactively to 30 June 2025; from 1 July 2025 a ministry department took over; vzbv says the DKG hospital directory is no independent, user-friendly alternative.
limitations: Status changed later (atlas now under G-BA).

title: Diskussion um mögliches Aus des Bundes-Klinik-Atlas
evidence_summary: Atlas covered about 1,700 hospitals and initially 26 conditions; DKG cites about 200,000 monthly visits vs 600,000 for the Deutsches Krankenhausverzeichnis and costs of about 1.5m EUR per year; VdK, vzbv and patient foundation opposed shutting it.
limitations: Search summary; DKG figures are interested-party estimates.

title: Bundes-Klinik-Atlas
evidence_summary: Atlas online with footer copyright 2026 Gemeinsamer Bundesausschuss; search by treatment, hospital comparison, Länder summaries; latest update uses data year 2024; 1,568 hospitals in statistics section; excludes psychiatric/psychosomatic facilities.
limitations: Does not show patient experience; operator change date not stated on page.

title: Deutsches Krankenhaus Verzeichnis
evidence_summary: Hospital search based on structured quality reports updated yearly, edited by hospitals; region, condition, equipment and accessibility search; job board; German and English.
limitations: Operator details not shown on homepage; hospital count not stated.

title: Das Reha-Portal (formerly Qualitätskliniken.de)
evidence_summary: qualitaetskliniken.de redirects to dasrehaportal.de; rehab clinic search, 2026 quality seal for clinics, more than 110,000 patient ratings; clinics can become paying members.

title: World's Best Hospitals 2026 – Germany
evidence_summary: Global ranking of 2,530 hospitals with Statista; weights: quality metrics 40%, peer recommendations 30% national + 5% international, patient experience 18.5%, PROMs survey 6.5%; Charité top in Germany (92.59%); 50+ German hospitals shown.
limitations: Commercial media ranking; German count not totalled on page.

title: Hintergrund: Wartezeiten in der Psychotherapie
evidence_summary: BPtK survey of over 9,000 psychotherapists: average wait of about 19.9 weeks (about 140 days) to start of guideline therapy; wait for first consultation fell from 12.5 to 5.7 weeks after 2017 Sprechstunde reform; 142.4 days in 2019.

title: 139 Tage im Schnitt warten auf Therapieplatz
evidence_summary: KV Bayerns study cited by federal government: 139 days on average between first consultation and start of psychotherapy; demand projected +23% over ten years.
limitations: Bavarian data; data year not stated.

title: Basisdaten Psychische Erkrankungen 2025
evidence_summary: 27.8% of adults (about 17.8m) meet criteria for a mental disorder within 12 months.
limitations: Prevalence based on older RKI survey; search summary.

title: Sechs Fakten zu den Honorarkürzungen in der Psychotherapie
evidence_summary: Treated quarterly cases rose from 4.6m (2013) to 7.4m (2023); about 3m patients per year in ambulatory psychotherapy, 1.6m in guideline therapy; about 600,000 Sprechstunde patients per quarter; providers +46.7% since 2015 but Kassensitze only +8.8%; group therapies +62% in two years; 3.8bn EUR extra-budgetary spending 2025; practices lose about 3% of fees under the 2026 cut.

title: Bericht über die Inanspruchnahme und Entwicklung der Versorgung mit DiGA 2025
evidence_summary: 74 DiGA admitted since 2020, 16 deleted, 58 listed end 2025 (48 permanent, 10 trial); 1.9m prescribed/approved, 1.6m activated; about 400m EUR spending; 2025 alone about 690,000 DiGA and over 170m EUR; usage +63% vs prior year; 51% prescribed by GPs; metabolic DiGA 37% of use, mental health 27% (35 DiGA); only 14 DiGA (19%) proved benefit at admission.

title: DiGA wachsen – Qualität und Preise müssen Schritt halten (PM 08.04.2026)
evidence_summary: Average manufacturer price 544 EUR in 2025 vs 411 EUR in first year; price range 119-2,077 EUR; 40 negotiated prices average 227 EUR; over 7m EUR paid for later-deleted DiGA.

title: ePA etabliert sich in der Versorgung
evidence_summary: gematik data: about 73m ePAs created; over 100m documents (13 Apr 2026); up to 93,000 practices access ePAs weekly (84,000 in Oct 2025); 5.1m registered GesundheitsIDs; over 21m medication-list retrievals per week.
limitations: Usage by insured persons themselves remains low (GesundheitsID).

title: Elektronische Patientenakte (ePA für alle)
evidence_summary: Insurers created ePAs from 15 Jan 2025 unless insured objected; nationwide rollout for providers from 29 April 2025; mandatory use for practices and hospitals from 1 Oct 2025; opt-out rate below 10% per BÄK (TK 7%, Barmer 5.3%, DAK under 4%).

title: Die Apotheke: Zahlen, Daten, Fakten 2026 – Entwicklung der Apothekenzahl
evidence_summary: Public pharmacies 16,601 end 2025 (lowest since late 1970s) vs 21,592 (2000), 18,753 (2020), 17,571 (2023), 17,041 (2024); closures 502 and openings 62 in 2025; main pharmacies 12,152 and branches 4,449.

title: Erreichbarkeit von Apotheken: Veränderungen durch Schließungen
evidence_summary: Between 2018 and 2023 more than 2m people saw distance to nearest pharmacy increase (about 1.6m increased, 493,000 strongly increased).

title: Statistik 2025: Tierärzteschaft in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland
evidence_summary: 46,089 vets in total, 34,476 working as vets (24,815 women); 11,216 self-employed (8,644 single practices); 12,125 practice assistants; 10,385 vet practices and 129 vet clinics summed across chambers (some estimated); 7,103 retired.
limitations: Practice counts partly estimated, excluding chain locations in some chambers.

title: Gebührenordnung für Tierärzte (GOT) 2022, § 12
evidence_summary: The new GOT entered into force on 22 Nov 2022, replacing the 1999 Tierärztegebührenordnung.

title: Daten & Fakten
evidence_summary: Pets live in 43% of German households (2025); pet supply market almost 7bn EUR (stationary 5.3bn, -0.7%; online 1.5bn).
limitations: No species counts on this page.

title: Daten und Zahlen
evidence_summary: 42,760 self-employed dentists end 2025 (57.6% of active dentists), -903 vs prior year; Niederlassungsquote 85.0% in 2000; dental MVZ grew from 46 (2015) to 1,511 (2024).

title: Nachgezählt
evidence_summary: 103,998 dentists, 73,511 active, 43,663 self-employed, 29,848 employed; 1,137 inhabitants per dentist; average age of self-employed 53.6; about 424,000-429,000 employees in dental practices.

title: 3-Prozent-Abschlag auf Hilfsmittel: Hörakustiker warnen vor Betriebsschließungen
evidence_summary: Hearing-aid acousticians warn of closures due to a planned 3% discount on Hilfsmittel; GKV Hilfsmittel spending +4% in Q1 2026 while hearing-system spending fell 1.3%.
limitations: Mechanism and law not described on page.

title: pflege.de
evidence_summary: Care guide portal with Pflegegradrechner, referrals to providers (bathroom conversion, stairlifts, Hausnotruf, care/24h staff), curabox supplies; over 400,000 newsletter subscribers; founded 2012.

title: Pflegelotse
evidence_summary: vdek care information and search portal with links to sister portals Arztlotse, Kliniklotse and Hospizlotse; address watch list, Leichte Sprache.

title: heimverzeichnis.de (current content)
evidence_summary: As of Nov 2026 the domain shows an online-casino listing, not a nursing home directory; no reference to the former Grüner Haken quality label.
limitations: Does not document when/why the former BIVA-related service ended.

title: therapie.de Psychotherapeutensuche
evidence_summary: Over 19,100 therapists with profiles, 407 new sign-ups in the last month; includes licensed psychotherapists and Heilpraktiker (Psychotherapie); trial listing 19 EUR.

title: Arztsuche 116117
evidence_summary: Official search for doctors and psychotherapists in statutory care with accessibility info from the Bundesarztregister; links to KZBV dentist search and DGUV accident doctor search; no quality ratings.
limitations: KBV cannot verify completeness of data.

title: compass private pflegeberatung
evidence_summary: PKV-founded care counselling by phone, video and home visit, free hotline 0800 101 88 00, Pflege Service Portal with care search, chatbot Caro Compass, packages for employers.

title: DocInsider
evidence_summary: Doctor and practitioner rating platform incl. physiotherapists and Heilpraktiker; city counts e.g. Berlin 32,504, Hamburg 17,064 entries; paid practitioner packages; no awards.

title: Doctolib Deutschland
evidence_summary: Online appointment booking, video consultations, specialty/city directory, Doctolib Pro for practices, mobile app.

title: Arzt-Auskunft
evidence_summary: Non-profit directory citing 530,000 medical contacts and 20,000 doctors with online booking; website quality seal for practices; paid premium profiles.

title: sanego Arztbewertung
evidence_summary: Rating portal listing 501,408 medical professionals and 594,848 reviews, plus 107,028 experience reports.

title: Tierarzt-Onlineverzeichnis
evidence_summary: Vet and animal clinic directory with opening hours and emergency services, over 11,000 vets listed, linked to pet insurance offers.

title: Bundes-Klinik-Atlas vor dem Aus? Gesundheitsministerium prüft Alternativen
evidence_summary: Reports criticism of the atlas as incomplete and hard to understand and that only about 26 care occasions could be displayed after the revision.

title: Qualität in Pflegeheimen: Wie wird sie gemessen und bewertet?
evidence_summary: Explains that Pflegenoten were replaced by a quality presentation based on indicators and external inspections; results shown per indicator relative to average.

title: Nach langem Streit: Bundeskabinett beschließt Pflegereform
evidence_summary: Cabinet adopted PNOG on 30 Sept 2026; package brings about 6.25bn EUR in 2027 vs 7.6bn EUR gap; commission to propose structural reform by end Jan 2027.

title: Projekt Weisse Liste
evidence_summary: Project page still describes Weisse Liste in present tense (transparency on care differences) but lists no posts newer than 2022; weisse-liste.de itself refused connections when tested on 2026-11-09.
limitations: Does not confirm whether or when the portal was discontinued.

title: BWP: Wärmepumpen-Absatz um 55 Prozent in 2025 gestiegen
evidence_summary: BWP reports 299,000 heating heat pumps sold in 2025 (+55%), 95% air-water, 16,000 ground-source; 49,500 hot-water heat pumps (+20%). KfW issued over 288,000 heat pump funding commitments in 2025 (+91%); nearly 80% of sales went into existing buildings; heat pumps were almost half of all heat generators sold.
limitations: Industry association figures relayed by trade media; no installer-level data.

title: Absatz von Wärmepumpen bricht 2024 um 46 Prozent ein
evidence_summary: Heat pump sales fell 46% to 193,000 in 2024 after a record 356,000 in 2023; air-source 178,000, ground-source 8,000. KfW BEG heating commitments in 2024 totalled 192,000, of which 151,000 for heat pumps; BAFA administered BEG heating funding before 2024.

title: Ausbau Erneuerbarer Energien 2025 (Pressemitteilung)
evidence_summary: Solar additions 2025 were 16.4 GW (slightly below 2024), total installed solar 117 GW vs 215 GW 2030 target. About 430,000 plug-in solar devices (approx. 0.5 GW) were registered in 2025, 3.2% of solar additions (2024: 2.5%, 0.4 GW). Figures based on Marktstammdatenregister registrations, December partly estimated.
limitations: Capacity not counts of installers; late registrations lead to revisions.

title: Mindestens zwei Millionen Wohnungen fehlen (barrierereduziertes Wohnen)
evidence_summary: Based on Mikrozensus 2022, about 1.2 million barrier-reduced dwellings (1.0 million with generous room sizes) exist versus just over 3 million mobility-restricted households, rising to 3.7 million by 2035; gap up to 2 million. Thuringia has only 16 suitable dwellings per 100 households in need, Brandenburg about 75.
limitations: Definitions of barrier-reduction differ across studies; projection is a model estimate.

title: KfW-Zuschüsse Barrierefreiheit 2026
evidence_summary: KfW 455-B had typically EUR 75m per year, doubled to EUR 150m in 2024; relaunched 8 April 2026 with EUR 50m and exhausted on 30 July 2026 after less than four months; 2027 draft budget contains no funds. Ministry estimated about 26,800 dwellings could be made barrier-reduced in 2026. Grants: 10% up to EUR 2,500 per single measure, 12.5% up to EUR 6,250 for the Altersgerechtes Haus standard.
limitations: Secondary news site; no application counts.

title: Wohnumfeldverbessernde Maßnahmen (Zuschüsse zur Wohnungsanpassung)
evidence_summary: Pflegekasse pays up to EUR 4,180 per adaptation measure for people with Pflegegrad 1-5; up to EUR 16,720 if four eligible persons live together. Examples: door widening, ramps, stairlifts, care-appropriate bathroom conversion.

title: Auswertung Treppenlift-Umfrage
evidence_summary: Verbraucherzentrale survey (Dec 2020) documents recurring stairlift complaints: contracts signed without clear consent, refusal of withdrawal rights, planning errors, safety defects and poor maintenance/service.
limitations: Self-selected online survey; not representative; seen only in search summary.

title: Trotz Todesfalls: 75 Prozent der Kosten als Kulanzangebot
evidence_summary: VZ Niedersachsen issued a warning (Abmahnung) to stairlift maker Lifta for demanding 75% of the price for a stairlift never installed after the intended user died.

title: Heizungsbranche meldet schwächsten Absatz seit 15 Jahren
evidence_summary: BDH: 627,000 heat generators sold in 2025 (-12%), weakest in 15 years; gas condensing boilers 229,000 (-36%), oil 22,500 (-74%), heat pumps about 299,000 (+55%), biomass about 29,000 (+23%). Heat pumps overtook gas boilers as best-selling heat generator.
limitations: Association figures; 2024 absolute total not stated.

title: Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz: Was die Eckpunkte bedeuten
evidence_summary: Government presented GMG key points on 24 Feb 2026: abolish 65% renewable rule, Bio-Treppe from 2029 (min 10% climate-neutral fuel for new gas/oil heating), Grüngasquote from 2028, zero-emission standard for public non-residential new builds from 2028 and all new builds from 2030; BEG to continue at least to 2029. co2online offers online checks (HeizCheck, WärmepumpenCheck, PhotovoltaikCheck etc.).
limitations: Key points, later superseded by adopted law.

title: Bundestag beschließt Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz: Breite Kritik trotz einzelner Zustimmung
evidence_summary: Bundestag adopted the Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz: the 65% renewable requirement for new heating systems is removed, oil/gas heating remains possible, rising climate-neutral fuel quotas from 2029, fuels fully climate-neutral by 2045. DUH announced a constitutional complaint; BEE, ZVEH, Greenpeace, BUND criticised it.
limitations: News; no vote counts in article.

title: Sanierungsquote 2024 weiter auf geringem Niveau
evidence_summary: B+L Marktdaten study for BuVEG: residential envelope renovation rate 0.69% in 2024 (2023: 0.70%, 2022: 0.88%); roof 0.74%, facade 0.5%, windows 1.19%; about 265,000 dwelling units renovated in 2024. About 2% p.a. would be needed for climate targets.
limitations: Envelope measures only, heating replacement excluded; extrapolated from order intake.

title: Talfahrt für energetische Gebäudesanierung geht weiter
evidence_summary: Residential renovation rate fell to a new low of 0.67% in 2025 (roof 0.74%, facade 0.46%, windows 1.19%); about 260,000 units renovated vs 460,000 needed per dena Leitstudie; non-residential rate 0.92% (prior year 0.95%).
limitations: Page returned 403; numbers from search summary only.

title: Energieeffizienz-Expertenliste für Förderprogramme des Bundes
evidence_summary: More than 22,800 experts are registered in the federal Energieeffizienz-Expertenliste, about 20,600 findable via search. Initiative of BMWE, BMWSB, BAFA, KfW and dena; listing linked to BEG funding eligibility; fee structure (Beitragsrechner) exists.
limitations: Exact reference date not stated; quality-control details on separate page.

title: BEG-Förderung 2025: Wärmepumpen-Anträge auf Rekordkurs
evidence_summary: Per BMWK: 146,739 BEG applications approved Jan-Jun 2025 vs 48,023 Feb-Jun 2024; 124,595 heat pump approvals in H1 2025 vs 153,576 in all of 2024; about 139,000 heat pumps sold in H1 2025. BEG budget 2026 EUR 12.1bn, of which EUR 7.7bn for single measures (heating).
limitations: Budget figures are plans, not disbursements.

title: SHK-Handwerk 2025: Umsatz und Aufträge rückläufig (PM 12/2026)
evidence_summary: SHK trade turnover 2025 about EUR 59.1bn (slightly below 2024), generated by about 48,000 businesses with 390,000 employees. 40,770 Anlagenmechaniker SHK apprentices in 2025 (+0.8%). About half of businesses report vacancies; investment hesitancy blamed on GEG/funding uncertainty.

title: Erster Umsatzrückgang seit zehn Jahren im SHK-Handwerk
evidence_summary: Number of SHK businesses fell slightly from 48,300 to 48,050 in 2024; employment down 0.4%; first turnover decline in ten years.

title: Solarspitzen-Gesetz im Bundesgesetzblatt veröffentlicht – Neuregelungen gelten ab 25. Februar
evidence_summary: Solarspitzengesetz adopted by Bundestag 31 Jan 2025, promulgated 24 Feb 2025, rules apply from 25 Feb 2025: new PV systems >=2 kWp get no EEG payment during negative prices (compensated by longer support period); new systems without control box limited to 60% feed-in. Negative prices occurred in about 5% of hours in 2024.
limitations: Fetch returned 404; details from search summaries of several sources.

title: Solarpaket I: Die vereinfachte Anmeldung für Ihr 800-Watt-Balkonkraftwerk
evidence_summary: Solarpaket I was adopted by Bundestag and Bundesrat on 26 April 2024 and applies from May 2024: plug-in solar inverter limit raised from 600 to 800 W, module power up to 2 kWp, grid operator notification dropped (MaStR registration simplified), landlords can no longer refuse without good reason.
limitations: Advice portal; exact in-force day not confirmed.

title: Zahl der Beschwerden über Photovoltaik-Anlagen 2023 mehr als verdreifacht
evidence_summary: Verbraucherzentralen recorded over 1,700 PV complaints in 2023 vs just under 500 in 2022 (+240%); 44% concerned delivery/performance failures, 14% warranty. Installations up to 30 kW rose from about 316,000 (2022) to about 750,000 (2023). ZVDH reported more roof damage from improper installation.
limitations: Complaint counts via Funke media report.

title: BSW-Solar: Mehr neue Photovoltaik-Anlagen auf Freiflächen und weniger auf Dächern 2025
evidence_summary: BSW-Solar estimates 2025 PV additions at about 17.5 GW (2024: 17.7 GW); ground-mounted about 8 GW (+25%), private rooftop down about 25% from 6.8 GW in 2024, commercial rooftop >30 kW about 3.7 GW (-5%), plug-in about 500 MW (+25%); cumulative about 118 GW.
limitations: Preliminary association estimate; minor internal inconsistencies noted.

title: In Deutschland sind über zwei Millionen Batteriespeicher installiert
evidence_summary: Over 2 million solar battery storage systems in operation (about 20 GWh, RWTH data); about 600,000 added in 2024; home storage now standard with new residential PV.

title: FAQ IHK-Zertifizierung für WEG-Verwalter
evidence_summary: WEG reform in force 1 Dec 2020; owners can demand a certified administrator from 1 Dec 2023 (§19(2) Nr. 6 WEG, postponed by one year in 2022); administrators in office on 1 Dec 2020 counted as certified until 1 June 2024; ZertVerwV exam regulation in force 17 Dec 2021; certification is separate from §34c licence.

title: FAQs § 34c GewO zum 24.07.2026
evidence_summary: Since 24 July 2026 estate agents (§34c(1) Nr.1 GewO) no longer have a statutory continuing-education duty; it remains for residential property managers (Wohnimmobilienverwalter). Certification is not a prerequisite for a Verwalter licence.

title: Preisindizes für Wohnimmobilien: Indizes und Veränderungsraten
evidence_summary: House price index fell 8.4% in 2023 (revised) and 1.5% in 2024; Q4 2025 prices were 3.0% above Q4 2024. Index rebased to 2025 in June 2026.
limitations: Seen via search summary; annual 2025 average from secondary source (3.2%) not used.

title: Preise für Wohnimmobilien im 2. Quartal 2026: +0,6 % zum Vorjahresquartal
evidence_summary: Residential property prices in Q2 2026 were 0.6% higher than a year earlier.

title: Gesetz über die Verteilung von Maklerkosten – Neue Regelung seit dem 23. Dezember 2020
evidence_summary: Since 23 Dec 2020 (§§656c, 656d BGB) buyers of flats and single-family homes may be charged at most half of the broker commission; broker contracts need text form; promulgated 23 June 2020.
limitations: Legal overview only; no market data.

title: VDIV veröffentlicht Branchenbarometer 2025: Immobilienverwaltungen zwischen Wachstum, Transformation und Fachkräftemangel
evidence_summary: 70% of property management firms report overload (a third severely); 57% dropped unprofitable mandates, 63% dropped very time-intensive properties; about 14% accept no new mandates; WEG fee increases of about 12% planned for 2025 (up to 17% for small properties); expected revenue growth 7.8%. VDIV has about 4,300 member firms.
limitations: Survey of members/participants (about 1,072 firms per other VDIV page); not a census.

title: Bundeskammerstatistik zum 01.01.2023
evidence_summary: As of 1 Jan 2023 there were 141,989 architects and urban planners, of whom 139,850 were chamber members; 137,153 members as of 1 Jan 2021.

title: Handwerk im Zeitverlauf
evidence_summary: Handwerk businesses: 1,028,138 (2021) to 1,038,126 (2025); employment relationships fell from 6.549m to 6.237m; turnover rose from EUR 684.1bn to EUR 783.2bn; apprentices 359,981 (2021) to 346,388 (2025). 2025 extrapolated.

title: Wohnungsbau 2025: Zahl der Fertigstellungen sank um 18%
Fertigbau kommt schneller aus der Krise: Fertighaus-Anteil 2025 Allzeithoch 26,5%
evidence_summary: BDF: prefab share of approved one/two-family homes reached record 26.5% in 2025 (13,473 of 50,755 approvals, total +14.6%); 2023: 24.5%, 2014: 16.2%; segment still almost 47% below 2021 in absolute terms; Baden-Württemberg 44.7%, Hessen 33%.
limitations: Secondary coverage; BDF release not opened.

title: KOFA Kompakt 07/2026: Fachkräftemangel im Handwerk
evidence_summary: In 2025 about 209,233 vacancies in Handwerk occupations met 139,173 unemployed craftspeople; skill gap 97,337 (almost every second vacancy), down only 9.5% vs -24.1% economy-wide. 59 of 115 Handwerk occupations show shortages, 35 for at least ten years. Bauelektrik: over 7 in 10 vacancies unfillable; SHK and roofing among top shortage occupations.

title: Grundsteuerreform: BFH bestätigt Bundesmodell – Praxisfolgen
evidence_summary: BFH on 10 Dec 2025 (II R 25/24, II R 31/24, II R 3/25) held the Grundsteuer Bundesmodell (used in 11 states) constitutional; new Grundsteuer applies since 1 Jan 2025; an estimate (Kirchhof) counts 2.8 million owner objections to assessments; constitutional complaints pending.
limitations: Objection count is an academic estimate via secondary sources.

title: Vielen Babyboomern droht Wohnungsnot im Alter
evidence_summary: Pestel-Institut study for BDB: 2.2 million age-appropriate dwellings missing today; 3.3 million needed by 2040 so older people can stay at home.
limitations: Publication date not confirmed; methodology differs from IW.

title: Projekt Energieberatung der Verbraucherzentrale
evidence_summary: About 233,000 people advised in 2024; almost 1,000 energy advisers at 900 Beratungsstellen and about 400 network partners; federal funding EUR 65.37m for 2025-2026.
limitations: Counts of consultations, not of providers.

title: Seit Juli 2026 gibt es den iSFP-Bonus erst ab 30.000 Euro Investition
evidence_summary: BAFA Energieberatung für Wohngebäude (iSFP) applications: 10,222 (2019), 24,621 (2020), 73,807 (2021), 134,921 (2022), 119,716 (2023), 157,351 (2024, peak), 112,805 (2025, -28%). Since 21 July 2026 iSFP bonus (+5 pp) only applies to eligible costs above EUR 30,000; cap per unit raised to EUR 60,000.
limitations: Secondary reporting of BAFA statistics; 2023 figure differs from Haus & Grund (130,600).

title: Energieberatung (Förderkürzung BAFA)
evidence_summary: From August 2024 the BAFA grant for residential energy advice was cut from 80% to 50% of the fee (max EUR 650 for 1-2 family homes, EUR 850 for 3+ units) citing high demand and budget; demand had multiplied from about 10,000 applications (2019) to about 130,600 (2023).

title: Kurzfristige Änderungen an der BEG-Förderung: Ab 21. Juli 2026 gelten neue Konditionen
evidence_summary: From 21 July 2026: heating base rate 30%, Klimageschwindigkeitsbonus 16% (falls 4 pp every half-year from 1 Feb 2027), income bonus 40/30/10% by household income bands up to EUR 50,000, eligible cost cap EUR 28,000 first unit (falling EUR 750 per half-year from Feb 2027); Made-in-EU bonus planned Q1 2027. Applications under old rules stopped 8 July 2026; no confirmations 9-20 July.

title: Thermondo erwartet für 2026 erstmals operativ einen Gewinn
evidence_summary: Thermondo revenue 2025 about EUR 212m (+47%), 5,456 heat pumps installed (+39%), about 3% market share of heat pump installations; increasingly uses external SHK partners.

title: 1Komma5° verdoppelt Absatz von Wärmepumpen 2025
evidence_summary: 1Komma5° more than doubled its international heat pump sales in 2025, with Germany as growth driver; over 10,000 units sold in Germany in two years.

title: Enpal erreicht Milliarden-Umsatz und baut Führungsteam um
evidence_summary: Enpal reportedly exceeded EUR 1bn revenue for the first time in 2025; previously reported about 4,300 installed heat pumps (year unclear).

title: Enpal schließt Vertriebsstandort Hamburg mit knapp 85 Mitarbeitern
evidence_summary: Enpal closed its Hamburg sales site; more than 80 employees released immediately; 1Komma5° founder offered jobs.

title: MyHammer Nachweis / Startseite
evidence_summary: MyHammer claims more than 100,000 clients use the platform monthly (average posted jobs Jan-Dec 2025) and displays 94,570 craftsmen on its homepage.

title: Partner werden: Heizung
evidence_summary: Aroundhome claims over 2,000 partners, about 1.5 million inquiries per year, 16 years in market; partners pay a fixed fee per qualified lead (no commission), each lead goes to at most three partners; 2,533 inquiries in last 7 days shown.
limitations: Self-reported marketing claims; no partner quality criteria stated.

title: Handwerker-Portale Vergleich 2026: Die Besten
evidence_summary: Comparison of craftsman portals: MyHammer subscription from EUR 25/month plus EUR 1-39 per contact and Handwerksrolle check; Check24 Profis EUR 50-120 per inquiry with basic trade-licence check; Blauarbeit from EUR 20/month; Aroundhome 5-10% of order value (sic); Google Business Profile free; client ratings Check24 Profis 4.9, MyHammer 4.2, Aroundhome 4.0, Blauarbeit 3.5.
limitations: Vendor blog; pricing for Aroundhome conflicts with Aroundhome's own page (per-lead fee).

title: Bellevue Best Property Agents 2026 – Bewerbungsunterlagen
evidence_summary: Seal awarded since 2006; criteria include seriousness, experience, expertise, objective advice, market knowledge, service range, web presence, portfolio, reliability; application, review and listing free; deadline 30 Sep 2025; seal licence via marketing packages: Basis EUR 845 and Profi EUR 2,595 (plus VAT) per year.
limitations: Methodology not quantified; number of awardees not stated.

title: SIS von Capital Makler-Kompass als Top-Makler Münchens mit Bestnote ausgezeichnet
evidence_summary: Capital Makler-Kompass 2025 was run for the twelfth time with IIB Institut using a two-stage test; awards five-star ratings city by city.

title: Homann Immobilien wirbt mit Bundessieg: Capital-Ranking erzählt jedoch eine andere Geschichte
evidence_summary: Local outlet disputes a broker's claim of a national win: Capital ranks brokers per city and awards no national winner; top score of 94 points reached in several cities.

title: Maklerquote stabilisiert sich im vierten Quartal 2025 bei 65 Prozent
evidence_summary: Share of owner-occupied flats listed by agents on ImmoScout24 in the 10 largest cities: 65% in Q4 2025, 67% in Q3 2025 (year high), 61% in Q4 2024 (low); Leipzig 75%, Dortmund 57%; based on 441,076 listings 2020-2025. ImmoScout24 has about 19 million monthly users.
limitations: Top-10 cities, flats only, platform data.

title: Servicestudie Treppenliftanbieter 2025 (Zusammenfassung)
evidence_summary: Mystery-shopping study of 6 large stairlift providers with own production and nationwide service (258 service contacts). Ranking: Acorn 75.6, Sonilift 75.1, Hiro Lift 71.9, Lifta 71.0, TK Home Solutions 66.8, Garaventa 62.8; industry mean 70.5 ('gut'). Full documentation costs EUR 400.
limitations: Only 6 providers; service quality not product/price.

title: Wohnsituation privater Haushalte 2022 (Mikrozensus-Zusatzprogramm Wohnen)
evidence_summary: Average rent burden 27.9% of household net income in 2022 (gross cold rent about EUR 598, EUR 8.70/m2). 61% of households with main earner 65+ had lived in their dwelling for more than 23 years (owners 78%, renters 43%).
limitations: Barrier-reduction tables not on this page.

title: Deutscher Bauherrenpreis
evidence_summary: Award since 1986 (40th anniversary 2026) under motto 'Hohe Qualität – tragbare Kosten'; 2026: 176 projects submitted, 30 nominated, 8 awarded (5 prizes, 3 special prizes); supported by federal building ministry and bdla.
limitations: Project award, not a provider ranking.

title: Best of Houzz
evidence_summary: Best of Houzz awarded annually in Design, Service, Photography based on community engagement and reviews; just over 2% of more than 3 million professionals on Houzz win; free; badge on profile.

title: nexxt-change Unternehmensnachfolgebörse
evidence_summary: Germany's largest business succession exchange; partners include ZDH, DIHK, BVR, DSGV; 22,300 matches since 2006; 431 regional partners.

title: wlw.de Startseite
evidence_summary: wlw lists about 600,000 B2B suppliers, 750,000 products, about 400,000 buyers per month in DACH; construction category with about 1,736 entries; premium profiles for suppliers.

title: Altersgerecht Umbauen – Investitionszuschuss (455-B)
evidence_summary: KfW states the 455-B grant can no longer be applied for because federal funds are exhausted; possible reopening if 2027 funds become available; loan 159 remains as alternative.

title: Gebäudeenergiegesetz 2025: aktueller Stand, Reformpläne und Handlungstipps
evidence_summary: GEG amendment in force 1 Jan 2024: 65% renewable rule for new heating in new development areas; for existing buildings linked to municipal heat planning deadlines 30 June 2026 (cities >100,000 residents) and 30 June 2028 (smaller).
limitations: Company blog; superseded by GModG in 2026.

title: Förderstopp für barrierefreien Umbau
evidence_summary: KfW 455-B funds ran out at end of 2024 and the 2025 federal budget contained no funds, so no grants could be applied for in 2025.

title: Schwerbehinderung: Zuschuss von 4000 € auf 4180 € pro Maßnahme angehoben
evidence_summary: §40 SGB XI grant for home adaptation raised from EUR 4,000 to EUR 4,180 per measure from 1 Jan 2025 due to inflation; next regular adjustment expected 1 Jan 2028.

title: CHECK24 Profis Bewertungen
evidence_summary: CHECK24 Profis shows 4.9/5 average on eKomi from 160 reviews in the last 12 months, 8,860 reviews overall.

title: GModG in Kraft: Was nun für Bestand und Neubau gilt
evidence_summary: Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz (GModG) passed Bundestag and Bundesrat on 10 July 2026, promulgated 28 July 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 226), first provisions apply from 29 July 2026; Bio-Treppe 10% from 2029 then 15/30/60%.
limitations: Search summary across several legal blogs.

title: Photovoltaik-Anlagen: So erkennen Sie unseriöse Anbieter von Solaranlagen
evidence_summary: Stiftung Warentest guidance on spotting dubious PV sellers: warning signs include advance payment, pressure to sign, generic systems not tailored to the building.

title: Warnung: Unseriöse PV-Anbieter mit dubiosen Zahlungsvereinbarungen
evidence_summary: VZ BW reports firms selling PV systems with dubious payment arrangements and defective installation, including roof damage cases.

title: Speicherbilanz 2024
evidence_summary: Home solar battery stock grew by about 580,000 to about 1.8 million in 2024 (about 15.4 GWh); almost half of the about 3.8 million PV systems in the home segment have storage.

title: Statistik Immobiliardarlehensvermittler (Juli 2026)
evidence_summary: Vermittlerregister lists 58,014 licensed real-estate loan intermediaries (§34i GewO) and 614 fee-based real-estate loan advisers; DIHK publishes no comparable §34c (estate agent/manager) statistic.

title: Absatz von Wärmepumpen legt im ersten Quartal 2025 wieder zu
evidence_summary: Heat pump sales rose 35% to 62,000 units in Q1 2025.

title: Wohnungsbau erholt sich: Baugenehmigungen steigen zweistellig
evidence_summary: 126,300 dwellings were approved in H1 2026, +15.1% year on year, strongest first-half growth since 2016.

title: Strukturerhebung im Dienstleistungsbereich: Grundstücks- und Wohnungswesen
evidence_summary: Structural survey shows about 174,500 enterprises in real estate activities (WZ 68) in 2010 and 205,300 in 2015; includes brokerage (68.31) and management for third parties (68.32).
limitations: Old data; subcategory counts not captured.

title: Als Immobilienmakler selbstständig machen
evidence_summary: Advice site states more than 32,000 self-employed estate agents are registered in Germany.
limitations: No method or source given; weak evidence; no official §34c statistic found.

title: Preise für Wohnimmobilien im 1. Quartal 2026: +1,4 % zum Vorjahresquartal
evidence_summary: Residential property prices in Q1 2026 were 1.4% above Q1 2025.

title: Bilanz 2025: Elektroauto-Neuzulassungen auf Rekordhoch
evidence_summary: Reports KBA annual figures: 545,142 BEV new registrations in 2025 (+43.2%, 19.1% share), 311,398 PHEV (10.9%), total market about 2.9 million (+1.4%). VW ID.7 top BEV model with 34,563.
limitations: Secondary report of KBA data; no figures for 2019-2022.

title: Über zwei Millionen E-Autos auf deutschen Straßen
evidence_summary: KBA stock data: 2,034,260 BEV on 1 Jan 2026 vs 1,651,643 on 1 Jan 2025 (+382,617, +23.2%), 4.1% of the 49,486,487 passenger cars.
limitations: Secondary report; KBA primary release not opened.

title: KBA veröffentlicht Bestandsdaten: 1,4 Millionen E-Autos
evidence_summary: KBA reported 1,408,681 BEV on 1 Jan 2024 (+39.1%), 2.85% of all passenger cars.

title: E-Auto-Bilanz 2024: Škoda top, Tesla flop
evidence_summary: Citing KBA: 380,609 BEV newly registered in 2024 (13.5% share), almost 144,000 fewer than in 2023 when the share was 18.4%.
limitations: Only two years; exact 2023 count not stated on page.

title: Bundesnetzagentur meldet über 169.000 öffentliche Ladepunkte
evidence_summary: BNetzA Ladesäulenregister: 169,082 public charging points on 1 June 2025, of which 128,198 normal and 38,669 fast charging points.
limitations: Register counts only operator-reported points; some AC points are company wallboxes flagged as public.

title: 17% Zuwachs: Deutschland kommt auf 194.000 öffentliche Ladepunkte
evidence_summary: 193,985 publicly accessible charging points on 1 Jan 2026 vs 165,295 on 1 Jan 2025 (about +17%).
limitations: Secondary report; the 1 Jan 2025 value appeared in search summaries of the same series.

title: Deutschland knackt Marke von 200.000 öffentlichen Ladepunkten
evidence_summary: 200,255 publicly accessible charging points registered on 1 April 2026.

title: Bilanz des Umweltbonus: 10,2 Milliarden Euro für 2,2 Millionen E-Fahrzeuge
evidence_summary: Umweltbonus paid about EUR 10.2 bn for about 2.2 million vehicles (over 1.4 million BEV, almost 800,000 PHEV, 475 fuel-cell) from 2016 until its abrupt end on 17 Dec 2023 after the constitutional court budget ruling.
limitations: Funding totals only; no analysis of market effect.

title: 28.493 Umweltbonus-Anträge zum Abschluss im Dezember
evidence_summary: BAFA: 28,493 applications in Dec 2023; 396,584 vehicle applications in 2023; 2,262,201 applications cumulated since 2016 (received, not approved).

title: Wallbox-Förderung: Fast 300.000 Antragsteller gehen leer aus
evidence_summary: KfW programme 440 (EUR 900 per private charging point) received 974,449 applications; only 689,980 were funded although budget was raised to EUR 800 m; about 284,000 unfunded. Programme stopped Oct 2021.
limitations: Installed wallboxes outside the programme unknown; page itself could not be rendered (fetch returned navigation only).

title: Fragen und Antworten zum Deutschlandticket
evidence_summary: Ticket costs EUR 63/month since Jan 2026 and EUR 66.80 from 1 Jan 2027 via a price index adopted by the Länder transport ministers; about 14.5 million customers; Bund and Länder each pay EUR 1.5 bn/year, Bund committed until 2030.
limitations: Earlier price points (49/58 EUR) not stated on this page.

publisher: Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Wohnen, Bau und Verkehr
title: Sonder-Verkehrsministerkonferenz in München
evidence_summary: Special transport ministers' conference on 18 Sep 2025 agreed to raise Deutschlandticket price by EUR 5 to EUR 63 from 1 Jan 2026, tied to EUR 1.5 bn annual federal funding until 2030.
limitations: Press release; Bundesrat formalities not covered.

title: After price increase in January: Deutschlandticket loses one million users
evidence_summary: Subscriptions fell from about 14.55 million (Dec 2024) to 13.55 million (Jan 2025) after the price rise to EUR 58.
limitations: Different counting methods across VDV/Statista series.

title: ZDK-Jahrespressekonferenz 2025, Statement
evidence_summary: Number of Kfz-Betriebe fell by 140 (-0.4%) to 36,030 in 2024 (brand-tied and independent each -70); employees -0.5% to 428,000; service/repair revenue +7.4% to EUR 36 bn.
limitations: Association data; definition of Betrieb per ZDK.

title: DAT-Report: Wo Autos gewartet und repariert werden
evidence_summary: DAT-Report counts 35,780 automotive businesses (annual revenue >= EUR 100,000) organised in Innungen in 2025.

title: Schnieder: Bezahlbarer Führerschein (Pressemitteilung 043/2026)
evidence_summary: Ministry states the Class B car licence costs about EUR 3,400 on average; reform to cut costs (no minimum number of special drives, optional/digital theory lessons).
limitations: Average cost figure not methodologically documented in snippet.

title: "Schnieder-Effekt": Bei Fahrschulen brechen Anmeldungen ein
evidence_summary: Survey by driving-school association Moving among about 2,400 driving schools: about 84% report fewer new registrations since Nov 2025 as learners wait for cheaper reformed licences.

title: Führerschein-Reform beschlossen: Das ändert sich ab 2027
evidence_summary: Reports Bundestag adoption of the driving-licence reform with main provisions applying from 1 July 2027; examination ordinance needs Bundesrat consent.
limitations: News; check Bundesgesetzblatt for binding dates.

title: TÜV Verband besorgt: Führerscheinprüfungen und Durchfallerquoten auf Rekordniveau
evidence_summary: TÜV-Verband data: in 2024 45% failed the Class B theory test and 37% the practical test; across all classes 41% theory and 30% practical.

title: Individualmobilität weiter hoch im Kurs: Führerscheinprüfungen nehmen stetig zu
evidence_summary: 2025: 2.04 million theory and about 1.89 million practical driving tests; failure rates 41% theory/31% practical overall, 44%/37% for Class B.

title: Schriftliche Anfrage 19/8157 (Fahrschulen in Bayern)
evidence_summary: As of 22 Aug 2025 Bavaria had 1,741 driving schools and 1,634 branch offices.
limitations: Bavaria only; no national total found.

title: Carsharing-Statistik 2026
evidence_summary: bcs: 18,390 station-based vehicles (+2.2%) and 978,300 station-based users (+11.8%) on 1 Jan 2026; 43,190 car-sharing vehicles in total (-4.9%); offers in 1,479 places.
limitations: Secondary; total vs station-based definitions not fully verified.

title: Carsharing wächst: Zahlen, Trends, Auswirkungen
evidence_summary: bcs statistic: 45,400 shared vehicles (+5.3%) at start of 2025; at least one provider in 1,393 municipalities (+108).

title: Fact Sheet Carsharing-Statistik 2024
evidence_summary: About 4.5 million (4,505,600) registered car-sharing users in Germany.

title: KOFA Kompakt Jahresrückblick 2025
evidence_summary: Skilled-worker gap fell 24.1% to 369,516 arithmetically unfillable vacancies in 2025; 33.3% of vacancies unfillable; biggest gaps Bauelektrik (16,270) and Altenpflege (15,233); 51.4% of occupations affected.

publisher: IAB (via onvista/dpa and IAB press list)
title: 1,15 Millionen offene Stellen in Deutschland im ersten Quartal
evidence_summary: IAB job vacancy survey: about 1.18 m (Q1 2025), 1.06 m (Q2), 1.03 m (Q3), 1.26 m (Q4 2025) and about 1.15 m (Q1 2026) open positions.
limitations: Quarterly values partly from secondary reports.

title: Fachkräfte bleiben knapp: Zuwanderung gewinnt weiter an Bedeutung (Presse 2026-32)
evidence_summary: Engpassanalyse 2025: 157 occupations with skilled-worker shortage (163 in 2024, 183 in 2023) out of ~1,200 assessed; about 402,000 vacancies for skilled roles on annual average 2025, about half in shortage occupations.

title: EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie: Deutschland verpasst Frist
evidence_summary: Germany missed the 7 June 2026 transposition deadline of Directive (EU) 2023/970; cabinet deliberation postponed to August 2026; national law expected to apply early 2027.
limitations: No confirmation of cabinet adoption found as of research date.

title: Rechtliche Einheiten/Unternehmen nach Beschäftigtengrößenklassen 2023
limitations: Units with >EUR 22,000 turnover or employees; secondary presentation of Destatis data.

title: Volkswirtschaftliche Bedeutung der KMU bleibt trotz Krisen hoch
evidence_summary: IfM Bonn: SMEs generated EUR 2.8 trillion turnover in 2023 (28% of total); over 99% of private-sector companies are SMEs.
limitations: Mittelstand (owner-managed) definition differs from KMU size definition.

title: Ausbildungsmarkt 2025 (Pressemitteilung)
evidence_summary: About 476,000 new dual training contracts (-2.1%), 530,300 places offered (-4.6%), 54,400 unfilled places (-21.6%), 84,400 applicants without place (+19.9%, highest since 2010), demand 560,300.
limitations: Snapshot on 30 Sep; excludes school-based training.

title: Anteil gestiegen: 25 % der Erwerbstätigen arbeiteten 2025 im Homeoffice
evidence_summary: Destatis Mikrozensus: 25% of employed worked at least occasionally from home in 2025 (2024: 24%, 2023: 23%, 2022: 24%, 2019: 13%); 74% in IT services/consulting vs 6% in gastronomy.
limitations: Self-reported, at least occasional home office.

title: Qualität der Arbeit: Weiterbildungsquoten
evidence_summary: AES (12-month reference): job-related further-training participation of employed 37% early 1990s, 48% 1997, ~50% 2012-2016, 60% 2020, 58% 2022. Labour Force Survey (4-week reference) 2025: 5.8%.
limitations: Series not comparable across methods/age ranges (AES 18-69 from 2022).

title: Qualifizierungsgeld: Bürokratiemonster oder Geldsegen?
evidence_summary: Qualifizierungsgeld (§§ 82a-82c SGB III) available since 1 April 2024 for employees whose jobs are threatened by structural change; it is a discretionary benefit.

title: wbmonitor Umfrage / Wirtschaftsklima in der Weiterbildung
evidence_summary: wbmonitor climate value for continuing-education providers fell to -4 in 2025 (scale -100..+100) from +13 in 2024, driven by publicly financed institutions; 1,115 providers responded in 2025.
limitations: Survey respondents, not full provider census.

title: Die Fakten: Transparenz Weiterbildungsanbieter
evidence_summary: Counts 13,962 continuing-education providers plus Volkshochschule branches, in total 16,841 verified providers.

title: Artikel 4 des EU AI Act: neue Pflichten für Unternehmen seit 2. Februar 2025
evidence_summary: AI literacy obligation (Art. 4 AI Act) applies since 2 Feb 2025 to all companies using or providing AI systems regardless of size; training is the typical but not the only measure.

title: KI-Kompetenz nach Art. 4 EU AI Act
evidence_summary: Notes that the Digital Omnibus weakens Art. 4 from 'ensure' to 'support' AI literacy; companies should expect a shifted, not removed, standard.

title: Studie: Bundesweit fehlen rund 430.000 Kita-Plätze
evidence_summary: Ländermonitor: about 430,000 Kita places missing (385,900 West, 44,700 East); NRW ~110,000, Bayern ~70,000, BW ~60,000; ~250,300 missing for under-3s in the West.
limitations: 2023 estimate; demand-based modelling; disputed by some Länder.

title: Zahl der betreuten Kinder sinkt infolge rückläufiger Geburtenzahlen
evidence_summary: 4,059,400 children in day care on 1 March 2025; about 61,000 Kindertageseinrichtungen (+400, +0.6%).

title: Kita-Bedarf bleibt trotz sinkender Geburtenzahlen hoch (Kindertagesbetreuung Kompakt 2025)
evidence_summary: Under-3 care quota 37.8% vs parental demand 49.3% (gap 11.5 pp); 801,281 under-3s in Kita/Kindertagespflege (-47,140); 95.3% of 3-to-school-age; KiQuTG ~EUR 2 bn in 2025 and 2026; EUR 4 bn special fund 2026-2029 for expansion.
limitations: No count of facilities or staff on the page.

title: Rechtsanspruch auf Ganztag startet zum 1. August 2026
evidence_summary: 57% of primary-school children (about 1.9 million) in full-day care; 74% of primary schools are Ganztagsschulen; EUR 3.5 bn federal investment to 2029; federal operating-cost share EUR 135 m/yr from 2026 rising to EUR 1.3 bn/yr from 2030; entitlement for grade 1 from 1 Aug 2026, grades 1-4 by 2029/30.
limitations: No missing-places figure on this page.

title: Dritter Bericht zum Ganztagsausbau an Grundschulen beschlossen
evidence_summary: About 264,000 places still missing nationally by school year 2029/30; for grade 1 in 2026/27 need of up to 30,000-65,000 places depending on scenario; most gap in western Länder.

title: Mehr Privatschulen in Deutschland
evidence_summary: About 3,800 private general schools in 2024/25 (2014/15: just under 3,600; +7%) vs gut 29,000 public (-4%); 807,900 of 8.9 m pupils at private schools (~9%); state shares MV 13%, SN 12%, BY 11%, SH/NI 6%; school fees 2021 avg EUR 2,042 for 599,000 children.

title: Anteil der Studierenden an privaten Hochschulen auf 12 % gestiegen
evidence_summary: Share of students at private universities rose from 1.6% (2001/02) to 11.6% (2021/22); about 342,600 students at private HEIs in 2021/22.

title: Studierende im Wintersemester 2024/2025
evidence_summary: Total students 2,868,600 in WS 2024/25 vs 2,868,300 in WS 2023/24; German students -1.0% to 2,376,000.

title: Wissenschaftsrat: Private Hochschulen fest verankert
evidence_summary: Almost 400,000 students at 116 private universities in Germany, roughly one in eight students.

title: ZEW Policy Brief 07/26 (private Hochschulen)
evidence_summary: Cites 108 private universities with 14% of all enrolled students in 2025.

title: Ausgaben für Nachhilfe
evidence_summary: Parents spend EUR 942-1,468 million per year on private tutoring; lower estimate avg EUR 108 per pupil (regional 74-131).
limitations: Study year not confirmed; other estimates range up to EUR 4 bn (Hans-Böckler).

title: Am 06.12.2025 tritt das NIS2UmsuCG offiziell in Kraft
evidence_summary: NIS2UmsuCG promulgated 5 Dec 2025 (BGBl. I Nr. 301), in force 6 Dec 2025 with a new BSIG; about 29,000 (other sources 29,500) entities affected; 3-month BSI registration (to ~6 March 2026) via Mein Unternehmenskonto.
limitations: Consultancy source; entity count is an estimate by BSI.

title: Wirtschaftsschutz 2025 (Studienbericht)
evidence_summary: Damage from theft, espionage and sabotage EUR 289.2 bn (2024: 266.6 bn, +8%); 70% (~EUR 202.4 bn) from cyberattacks; 87% of firms affected (prior year 81%); n=1,002.

title: Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG)
evidence_summary: BFSG applies from 28 June 2025 to e-commerce services (online shops with ordering/payment) and certain products; micro-enterprises providing services are exempt; market surveillance by MLBF AöR in Magdeburg.

title: Jedes fünfte Unternehmen nutzt künstliche Intelligenz
evidence_summary: 20% of companies with 10+ employees used AI in 2024 vs 12% in 2023.

title: KI in Unternehmen Deutschland 2026 – Datenmonitor
evidence_summary: AI use 2025: 26% of companies with 10+ employees; 23% small (10-49), 36% medium (50-249), 57% large (250+).

title: Lichtblick in der Rezession: Digitalbranche wächst
evidence_summary: ITK employment expected to rise by ~9,000 to 1.354 million in 2025; ITK market +4.4% to EUR 235.8 bn.
limitations: Forecast; earlier release had different baseline.

title: Deutschland fehlen IT-Fachkräfte
evidence_summary: About 109,000 IT specialists are currently missing in the German economy.

title: DAT-Barometer: Bestand & E-Mobilität (04/25)
evidence_summary: Based on KBA data: private buyers acquired more used than new BEVs in 2024 (173,034 ownership transfers vs 136,570 private new registrations); BEV ownership transfers Q1 2025 50,423 (+~61%).
limitations: Excludes commercial buyers in the private comparison.

title: Gebrauchte Elektroautos: Akku-Check vor dem Kauf (AVILOO)
evidence_summary: Battery health certificates offered by ADAC, TÜV, DEKRA, GTÜ and AVILOO; AVILOO ~EUR 99 (load test); DEKRA ~EUR 150, TÜV SÜD EUR 125, GTÜ EUR 100-130 (resistance measurement); TÜV-Verband cites EUR 100-200; TÜV Rheinland founded Battery Quick Check GmbH.
limitations: Prices vary; promotional sources mixed in.
